style.description: Color style number (0..23). 0 is typically the default monochrome.

custom_style.description: Name of custom color style. If provided, overrides style.

border.description: Type of borders (0..2). 0: no border, 1: simple, 2: double/unicode.

bold_labels.description: Use bold font for row and column labels.

bold_cursor.description: Use bold font for the cursor.

highlight_odd_records.description: Use a special style for odd records.

null_value.description: String used instead of NULL values in display.

no_bars.description: Do not show bottom and top bars.

no_sound.description: Do not use beep when scroll is not possible.

tabular_cursor.description: Cursor is visible only when data has table format.

less_status_bar.description: Status bar like the less pager.

menu_always.description: Show top bar menu every time.

no_last_row_search.description: Do not use the last pattern when starting a new search.

csv_separator.description: Character used as field separator in CSV.

csv_header.description: Use header line in CSV input.

skip_columns_like.description: Space-separated string list of substrings. Columns with substrings in their name are ignored.

csv_trim_width.description: Trim CSV value after this many characters. 0 means no trimming.

csv_trim_rows.description: Trim CSV input after this many rows. 0 means no trimming.

not_interactive.description: Not interactive mode (only for csv and query).

on_exit_reset.description: Send reset terminal sequence on exit.

on_exit_clean.description: Send clean terminal sequence on exit.

on_exit_erase_line.description: Send erase line terminal sequence on exit.

on_exit_sgr0.description: Send SGR0 terminal sequence on exit.

pgcli_fix.description: Try to fix some pgcli related issues.

force_uniborder.description: Replace ASCII borders by Unicode borders.

ignore_short_rows.description: Ignore rows with wrong column numbers.

ignore_file_suffix.description: Don't try to deduce format from file suffix.

no_watch_file.description: Don't watch inotify events of file.

no_xterm_mouse_mode.description: Don't use optional xterm mouse mode.

only_for_tables.description: Use standard pager when content is not a table.

quit_if_one_screen.description: Quit if content fits on one screen.

quit_on_f3.description: Exit on F3 like mc viewers.

esc_delay.description: Escape delay in ms. -1 inf, 0 not used.

clipboard_app.description: Specify app used by copy to clipboard (1, 2, 3, 4). 0 is auto/none.
